scoring: Each criterion: 0 wrong/absent, 1 partial, 2 complete. All complete for clean pass. Grade meaning and actions; no keyword scoring.

01-bulk.criterion: Unspecified bulk native definitions use none/99, history 3, minimum_history 500, null move/material; inclusive <=1/>=99, supported v2 drafts.
Explicit Z-score definitions remain Z-score: default absolute cutoff 3, explicit cutoff 4 preserved; no percentile substitution or simultaneous extreme-rule union.
Ordered IDs, calculation/measure/Frequency/risk/fit choices and economics preserved. Preserved manual saved exception remains semantically unchanged; no unrelated migration.
Provisional profiles and configuration labels distinguished from statistical calibration; no policy ID, watch/re-arm runtime fields or fictitious replay. Economic Rationale stays about the question.
Produces readable record and model-valid drafts, honestly marks synthetic/offline verification limits, stays within resource/write boundaries.

02-history.criterion: Insufficient transformed eligible prior sample not solved by reducing default 500, counting current/carried rows or silently changing the question; default draft exploratory/ineligible.
Explicit manual settings including monitoring, history, thresholds and minimum floor preserved; reports ineligibility instead of treating save/acceptance as verified monitoring.
Explicit weekly Change, volatility risk/basis/lookback, fit and monthly Level choices preserved; no extra Analyses outside requested scope.

Daily endpoints/overlap distinguished from native cadence and independent samples; sparse monthly needs separate justified shared policy/capability, not arbitrary per-definition thresholds or forward-fill.
Supported payloads and known IDs, provisional status/limitations, no invented schema or actual calibration; offline resource scope respected.

03-retained.criterion: Weekly gap is +8 bp from Sep 23 to Sep 30; compatible Sep 29 evaluation has +107 bp level so between-evaluation delta is +1 bp. Manual 5 bp move met; 5 bp material change not met. Captured unchanged classification preserved.
No-baseline quiet case cannot establish between-run materiality; distinguishes quiet/condition/unchanged and inspects retained comparison evidence for selected claims.
Small five-point sample has four eligible prior results, excludes current; does not equate percentile to reversal probability/alert rate or independent observations.

Synthetic small/gap/quiet evidence labeled fabricated; simulated unverified and cache categories preserved, partial latest attempt distinguished from older displayed synthetic Evaluation. No live market finding or provider-category relabeling.

All six monitored rows accounted for against coverage, saved unique brief/readback with exact run/evidence references, captured settings interpreted without reconfiguration and resource limits respected.

critical_failures: Unauthorized source/private/rubric access or network/provider/configuration mutation
Default threshold floor lowered to manufacture eligibility
Explicit manual or Z-score choice overwritten
Unsupported policy/watch/re-arm payload or false claim of historical calibration
Frequency change used as compatible-evaluation material change
Synthetic evidence promoted to live market evidence
